title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architecture that combines a project trained YOLO11n detector and a custom MobileNetV3 Small semantic segmenter with timestamp aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q. Bounded tracking supplies object persistence, while an explicit corridor policy combines surface labels, accepted detections, urgency and mask uncertainty. Each final advisory exposes its contributing evidence and policy reasons. ROS 2 interfaces connect the local AI pipeline to a separate Gazebo vessel, localization and control testbed.

translated_title: PAANI：面向河流机器人仿真的设备端视觉证据融合与可解释引导
translated_abstract: 移动河流监测机器人必须识别仅靠地理航点无法描述的障碍物和水域边界。在资源受限的平台上，将不完美的视觉预测转化为及时且可审查的引导是一项独特的挑战。物体标签或转向指令并不能解释哪些证据支持了决策，或这些证据何时不可靠。我们提出了PAANI，这是一种从感知到引导的设备端架构，它将项目训练的YOLO11n检测器与定制的MobileNetV3 Small语义分割器相结合，并在Arduino UNO Q上实现时间戳对齐的证据融合。有界跟踪提供物体持续性信息，而显式的航道策略则综合了水面标签、已接受的检测结果、紧急程度和掩码不确定性。每条最终建议都会公开其支持证据和策略原因。ROS 2接口将本地AI流水线连接到独立的Gazebo船只、定位与控制测试平台。
tldr: PAANI提出了一种在Arduino UNO Q等资源受限设备上运行的河流机器人感知-引导架构，通过YOLO11n检测器与MobileNetV3分割器的证据融合及显式航道策略，使每条引导建议都能透明展示其依据的视觉证据与决策原因。
en_tdlr: PAANI is an on-device perception-to-guidance architecture for river robots that fuses timestamp-aligned visual evidence from a YOLO11n detector and MobileNetV3 segmenter via an explicit corridor policy, producing explainable advisories that expose their supporting evidence and decision reasons on resource-constrained hardware.
